title: The Elon Times — ledger story v2, November 25, 2026
headline: Cybercab opens to the public in Dallas as Tesla turns autonomy into a service
dek: In one week Tesla started public two-seat Cybercab rides in a second city, began rolling out FSD v15 toward a December wide release, and attached a required $299 monthly subscription to personal Cybercab orders — while Italy approved Assisted Driving and the EU committee meeting slipped to December 15.
scope: Recent news, roughly November 17–25, 2026, plus a few immediately adjoining rows used as hooks or context (Mini 2 Nov 10 / invite preorders Nov 23; Robotaxi 24/7 Nov 11; Flight 15 Nov 14; Berlin expansion and Starbase permit Nov 16). Historical backfill from v1 is omitted.
note: Facts are taken from ledger rows and their sources. Interpretation is labeled Chronicle’s read. events.json was not modified for this story. No event used here has ledger media; the front is typographic only.

unverified_or_incomplete_in_ledger_sourc.detail: Tesla’s November 13 post established a required $299-a-month Autonomy Subscription. The line that the car “will not operate without” the subscription, and the bundle of services, is reported from buyer screenshots via Teslarati, not from a public Tesla page.

About $738 million is attributed to Teslarati and Quartz; about $636 million to Telecompetitor. Teslarati has a URL in the row sources. Quartz and Telecompetitor are named in the status note but have no URLs in the ledger sources. NTIA’s page does not state a figure.

unverified_or_incomplete_in_ledger_sourc.item: Starlink Mini 2 U.S. preorders by invitation, November 23
unverified_or_incomplete_in_ledger_sourc.detail: The November 23 invitation is in the row summary and status note. The only source URL on the row is the November 10 introduction post.

unverified_or_incomplete_in_ledger_sourc.item: Cyberbeast price and lease change, TeslaNorth
unverified_or_incomplete_in_ledger_sourc.detail: The November 25 status note cites Not a Tesla App and TeslaNorth. Only Not a Tesla App is in the row’s sources list.

unverified_or_incomplete_in_ledger_sourc.item: X UK High Court judgment terms
unverified_or_incomplete_in_ledger_sourc.detail: Medium confidence. Award amount and terms are not public. The November 20 order date is TeslaNorth’s reading of the first page Burnham posted.
Reported by the Financial Times on November 24, via Electrek; not confirmed by either company. No agreement or filing.
All events used in this story have image none or null. The front page is typographic only.
